structured_output.outcome: Duplicate of #1 — fold into it at Thursday triage. Learner outcome not stated in the request; #1 states it ("learners with no distribution channel share the referral at least once"). Not blocking; #1 needs three refinement decisions before Ready.

urgency.claim: None stated. The request describes friction, not a deadline or a loss.
urgency.evidence: One observation: learners currently copy a code and explain it themselves. No counts of learners who copy, share, drop, or ask support how referral works.
urgency.assessment: Not urgent on the evidence given. Arrived out of process on Wednesday; joins Thursday triage in the normal order. If ops wants it ahead of the queue, it owes the numbers behind the friction claim by Thursday.

duplicate.why: #1 already covers a dashboard card with a one-tap way to send the referral link, plus the stated exchange and a learner outcome. This request is a strict subset of #1 and adds no new scope or evidence.

size.risk: If the per-learner referral link and market eligibility live only in the external programme/finance system with no API myNXU can read, this becomes L: new integration plus finance in the loop for amounts per market.

questions.text: What is the pass/fail for 'shared' — a share-sheet tap, a link delivered, or a referred learner who starts? And what is today's baseline (how many learners copy the code, how many referrals start per month)?
Does every eligible learner already have a per-learner link today, or only a code? Who issues it — the referral programme system, finance, or myNXU?
Can myNXU read the learner's referral link and their market eligibility (finance-set markets and amounts) from an existing source, or does this need a new integration?
Which share mechanism: native share sheet, copy-link, or a pre-filled message? What does the message say to state the exchange, and what does the card show when the learner's market is ineligible?

structured_output.requester_message:
Your request to share a referral link from the dashboard is already covered by open issue #1 (Refer a friend — link first, the exchange stated). I'm attaching yours to it rather than opening a second issue; it goes to triage Thursday.

Two things owed from you by Thursday so #1 can move: (1) what "shared" means for pass/fail — a tap, a link sent, or a referred learner who starts — and the baseline today: how many learners copy the code, how many referrals start per month. (2) Whether every eligible learner already has a link today or only a code, and which system issues it.

The current sprint is committed. Nothing in this request says it must jump the queue; if you believe it should, the numbers above are what triage weighs it on, and an item of matching size would leave the sprint to make room. Provisional size is a sprint for one person, less certain until engineering confirms myNXU can read the referral link and market eligibility without a new integration with finance's system.
